name: security-android-backup-exclusions-review
intent: Android backup/device-transfer rules for declared sensitive app data
artifacts: App/OS version, backup and extraction rules, data locations, build flags and owned backup/restore fixture.
trace: Determine which files participate in actual backup and device transfer paths, separating platform versions and debug tooling.
experiment: Use an emulator/test account and synthetic secret marker; inspect an owned supported backup or restored app without extracting real-user data.
disproof: A file in private app storage is not automatically excluded from every transfer; unsupported adb backup behavior cannot prove current platform exposure.
repair: Exclude or protect sensitive persisted data under the actual backup modes and verify legitimate restoration.
branch_decisions: Branch on Android version, cloud backup versus device-to-device transfer and the installed build rules. A single allowBackup value does not describe every transport/version. Determine whether the threat model grants backup extraction access and whether restored data remains useful under keystore/account binding, without collecting production app backups.
operational_method: Resolve OS/target build and supported transport before selecting fullBackupContent or dataExtractionRules and its applicable cloud/device-transfer/cross-platform section. Missing rules in a supported mode can differ from an explicit exclusion; allowBackup=false is not a universal guarantee across OEM transfer paths. Retain the effective build rules and an owned synthetic backup/restore artifact for the selected mode. Do not infer current cross-platform behavior from an old two-transport fixture.
